sentences.text: Plans to switch off the UK's traditional landline phone network could leave people in remote areas unable to contact help in an emergency, MPs have warned.
sentences.article_title: Landline switchover could cut people off in emergency, minister warned

sentences.text: Landline operators aim to complete the switch to an internet-based network instead of copper-wire cables by the end of January next year.
sentences.article_title: Landline switchover could cut people off in emergency, minister warned

sentences.text: The government and operators say the move to digital landlines will offer a more reliable service.
sentences.article_title: Landline switchover could cut people off in emergency, minister warned

sentences.text: But MPs representing remote areas of the UK urged security minister Dan Jarvis to ensure that scrapping the copper-wire network did not make their communities more vulnerable in a storm or other emergency.
sentences.article_title: Landline switchover could cut people off in emergency, minister warned

sentences.text: Unlike digital services, the traditional landline network does not rely on mains electricity and continues to work in a power cut.
sentences.article_title: Landline switchover could cut people off in emergency, minister warned

sentences.text: Retail service providers have been giving back-up battery packs to vulnerable customers, which can keep landline phones operating for an hour or more.
sentences.article_title: Landline switchover could cut people off in emergency, minister warned

sentences.text: But Crichton said this was "simply not adequate" and that mobile phone providers "simply don't have the means to maintain or keep their signal going during storms".
sentences.article_title: Landline switchover could cut people off in emergency, minister warned

sentences.text: He urged the minister to get telecoms firms to "up their digital game" to protect places "on the edge where people are vulnerable, isolated from their neighbours, where the ambulance is an hour away and the storm is 70 miles an hour".
sentences.article_title: Landline switchover could cut people off in emergency, minister warned

sentences.text: Similar concerns were raised by MPs from the West Country and the Lake District.
sentences.article_title: Landline switchover could cut people off in emergency, minister warned

sentences.text: Markus Campbell-Savours, Labour MP for Penrith and Solway, said: "I ask the minister to imagine an elderly constituent living alone in an isolated Lake District valley where copper phone lines have been replaced by fibre.
sentences.article_title: Landline switchover could cut people off in emergency, minister warned

sentences.text: He told Jarvis the copper-wire network "could have given us useful levels of resilience in an emergency".
sentences.article_title: Landline switchover could cut people off in emergency, minister warned

sentences.text: Jarvis, who is spearheading the government's Be Ready campaign, which is advising people to stock up on supplies to be prepared for emergencies , said he would "look very closely" at the Tory MP's point.
sentences.article_title: Landline switchover could cut people off in emergency, minister warned

sentences.text: He also assured West Country MPs that their concerns would be addressed at a government resilience summit, which was due to take place in Cornwall next month, and promised to raise concerns about telecoms firms with the Department for Culture, Media and Sport.
sentences.article_title: Landline switchover could cut people off in emergency, minister warned

sentences.text: "Our telephone networks are a vital part of our critical national infrastructure and our emergency response in weather-related crisis supports the functioning of essential services and keeping people connected when they need it most," he told MPs.
sentences.article_title: Landline switchover could cut people off in emergency, minister warned

sentences.text: The government says the switch to digital phone services is needed because the traditional analogue network is becoming increasingly unreliable.
sentences.article_title: Landline switchover could cut people off in emergency, minister warned

sentences.text: The government's Be Ready campaign advises people , external who have not yet "migrated to a modern digital network" to contact their landline provider.
sentences.article_title: Landline switchover could cut people off in emergency, minister warned

sentences.text: "If you are a vulnerable customer, for example if you are a telecare user, your communication provider must provide a free back‑up battery unit," it adds.
sentences.article_title: Landline switchover could cut people off in emergency, minister warned

sentences.text: More information is available on the government's digital switchover site , external .

sentences.text: Real estate brokers Oren and Tal Alexander and their brother Alon, listen as their lawyers argue for a lesser sentence on their behalf in New York Three brothers - two of them wealthy real-estate moguls - were sentenced to 30 years each in prison for drugging and raping dozens of women over decades.
sentences.article_title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

sentences.text: Tal Alexander, 40, and twins Oren and Alon Alexander, 39, were found guilty in March of using their wealth and social status to lure women to parties and luxury homes, where they sexually assaulted them.
sentences.article_title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

sentences.text: "Your conduct was monstrous," said Judge Valerie Caproni before sentencing them.
sentences.article_title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

sentences.text: "Your crimes wreaked havoc on their lives." On Tuesday morning, the court in New York heard from 12 victims, including one who did not testify during the trial.
sentences.article_title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

sentences.text: One by one, they spoke of the psychological trauma they endured after the Alexander brothers raped them, and their desire for the shame they had felt to instead fall on the defendants.
sentences.article_title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

sentences.text: Many asked the judge to impose the maximum sentence of life in prison for each brother.
sentences.article_title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

sentences.text: Maya Miller told the court that after Tal Alexander raped her in 2014, she lost all sense of safety.
sentences.article_title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

sentences.text: "I carry a quiet funeral within me for the person I might've become if this never happened to me," she said.
sentences.article_title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

sentences.text: Another victim, using the pseudoym Isa Brooks, said after being raped by Tal and Alon Alexander when she was 16, she lost the ability to trust herself.
sentences.article_title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

sentences.text: "I had no idea the danger I was in till it was too late," she said.
sentences.article_title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

sentences.text: Another woman said when she planned to come forward about being raped, Tal Alexander threatened her, saying he knew where her sister worked.
sentences.article_title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

sentences.text: Prosecutor Elizabeth Espinosa said the brothers deserved the maximum punishment for their crimes, saying facts "paint a truly devastating picture".
sentences.article_title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

sentences.text: "For years, they honed their methods of luring women with the promise of luxury," she said, adding that they were "completely unmoved by the path of suffering they left behind them." During the women's speeches, the three Alexander brothers showed little emotion.
sentences.article_title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

sentences.text: They stared ahead or conferred with their lawyers, who said they advised their clients not to look at the victims so it couldn't be misconstrued.
sentences.article_title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

sentences.text: Attorneys for the brothers pushed for sentences of 15 years, arguing that they had become devoted fathers whose families would suffer in their absence.
sentences.article_title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

sentences.text: The three men all addressed the court, continuing to profess their innocence.
sentences.article_title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

sentences.text: "We had a work-hard, play-hard mentality," Tal Alexander said, adding he saw how his behavior "hurt people's feelings".
sentences.article_title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

sentences.text: But their statements did not assuage Caproni, who chastised them for refusing to admit their crimes.
sentences.article_title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

sentences.text: "How can someone who never acknowledged the wrongs they did be rehabilitated?" she asked.
sentences.article_title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

sentences.text: At the end of the hearing, she sentenced them each to 30 years in prison for certain crimes.
sentences.article_title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

sentences.text: She also sentenced each to 20 years in prison for additional crimes, but said the men would serve the sentences concurrently.
sentences.article_title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

sentences.text: Prosecutors said the brothers' pattern of abusive behaviour began in high school, though the trial involved crimes starting in 2008.
sentences.article_title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

sentences.text: They said the three slipped drugs into women's drinks, and "physically restrained and held down their victims during the rapes and sexual assaults and ignored screams and explicit requests to stop".
sentences.article_title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

sentences.text: Lawyers for the brothers argued the sex was consensual and that they were womanisers, but not abusers.
sentences.article_title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

sentences.text: Two of the brothers, Tal and Oren, became wealthy selling luxury properties in New York and Miami.
sentences.article_title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

sentences.text: They worked for American real estate giant Douglas Elliman, with clients including Lindsay Lohan, Kim Kardashian and Kanye West.
sentences.article_title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

sentences.text: In 2022, they founded their own New York-based firm called Official.
sentences.article_title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

sentences.text: Alon worked at the family's private security firm, Kent Security.
sentences.article_title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

sentences.text: As they heard their sentences, the brothers stared straight ahead.

sentences.text: Wednesday will be a day of some sunny spells and showers but as winds turn lighter into Thursday, extensive fog is expected to form.

sentences.text: Two quotes from the chancellor and the prime minister get to the heart of this Budget.
sentences.article_title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises

sentences.text: "The money New Labour had in the 90s is simply not there now… Britain has it harder now," Chancellor John Healey said last month.
sentences.article_title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises

sentences.text: And from Andy Burnham, days before he became prime minister: "This change... is the most significant change moment in our politics for 40 years." So what happens when the economic realities confront the political ambitions of this new government?
sentences.article_title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises

sentences.text: As Helen Miller, director of the Institute for Fiscal Studies (IFS), puts it , external : "We have a relatively new government with seemingly big ambitions but facing a long list of constraints.
sentences.article_title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises

sentences.text: "Some of those constraints… are self imposed, others are being worsened by global events, most noticeably war in the Middle East." Let's be clear, plenty in Westminster in all parties will say that the amount of money around isn't everything – how well taxpayers' money is spent and where it is spent matters too.
sentences.article_title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises

sentences.text: And spending less and taxing less, plenty argue, should be a priority.
sentences.article_title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises

sentences.text: But in the bones of many in the Labour Party is an instinct that the government, the state, can and should be a vital agent in driving change and improvements in people's lives – a world-view grounded in a sense that governments should proudly step in, rather than one that believes they should get out of the way.
sentences.article_title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises

sentences.text: And how do you deliver a proudly proactive state, delivering for people in a noticeable way, when the tax burden is generationally high, the national debt is sky high, energy bills are rising and inflation is higher than expected?
sentences.article_title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises

sentences.text: In short: it is not easy.
sentences.article_title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises

sentences.text: Minimum wage set to rise but 18-20 year-olds will not get bigger increase Tax on banks, energy bill help and minimum wage rise - what could be in the Budget?
sentences.article_title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises

sentences.text: Healey's Budget needs to sustain the stronger economy through gathering clouds But ministers argue all of this doesn't mean the government is powerless.
sentences.article_title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises

sentences.text: Many are expecting support on the cost of living, and in particular energy bills, to be targeted at the most vulnerable.
sentences.article_title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises

sentences.text: On the eve of the Budget, Healey said he wants to "start the long-term action needed to get energy costs down for good".
sentences.article_title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises

sentences.text: The banks are braced for a levy or surcharge that may pay for this.
sentences.article_title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises

sentences.text: There will be an announcement about further spending on defence, but not yet how spending 3% of national income on our security will be delivered by 2030 – that will come in next year's Spending Review.
sentences.article_title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises

sentences.text: And one of the prime minister's key ideas - handing power away from Westminster and closer to you, devolution - will be central too.
sentences.article_title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises

sentences.text: The chancellor will argue the economy is becoming more robust – and yes, there are some economic indicators that are more positive than forecast: growth is better than expected, as is productivity and unemployment is down.
sentences.article_title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises

sentences.text: But as the Resolution Foundation think tank points out , external : "John Healey's problem is that conflict in the Middle East has once again pushed up energy prices and interest rates.
sentences.article_title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises

sentences.text: The chancellor has been talking up a desire to offer "breathing space" and "hope" - a tacit acknowledgement that there is a limit to what the government can do given the constraints it faces.
sentences.article_title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises

sentences.text: It has promised not to raise income tax, national insurance or VAT, a self imposed constraint, as the IFS put it.
sentences.article_title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises

sentences.text: And there are the international ones beyond its control too.
sentences.article_title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises

sentences.text: The big question for many will be whether the Budget is – or can be - big enough to meet the moment?
sentences.article_title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises

sentences.text: Opposition parties will argue it amounts to tinkering.
sentences.article_title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises

sentences.text: Conservative shadow chancellor Andrew Griffith argued the public finances are "on a cliff edge" and wants Healey to use the Budget to "take tough decisions, instead of continuing to kick the can down the road".
sentences.article_title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises

sentences.text: For the Liberal Democrats, Daisy Cooper warned a "steady as she goes" Budget is "not going to cut it", while Reform UK's Robert Jenrick said the chancellor "can't keep fiddling while the economy burns".
sentences.article_title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises

sentences.text: Green Party MP Ellie Chowns wanted a "bold" approach but fears it will be "business as usual".
sentences.article_title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises

sentences.text: The government will try to convince you it is one of many moments in the coming weeks and months that will attempt to deliver the scale of change the prime minister has promised.

sentences.text: (From left to right) Norman Macksoni, Richard Wilkins, Connor Sanderson-Doyle and Mohammed Hassan are all on trial at Winchester Crown Court Four men sexually assaulted a woman after her then-husband drugged her and advertised her on Craigslist, Grindr and swinging websites, a court has been told.

sentences.text: Norman Macksoni, 48, Richard Wilkins, 62, Connor Sanderson-Doyle, 32, and Mohammed Hassan, 38, are on trial at Winchester Crown Court after pleading not guilty to sexual offences against Joanne Young.
sentences.article_title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told

sentences.text: They are charged jointly with her ex-husband Philip Young, 50, a former Conservative councillor, who has admitted to drugging and raping her over 13 years.
sentences.article_title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told

sentences.text: But on one occasion in 2023, she said she had woken up with restraints and a blindfold on while a man was carrying out a sexual act on her.

sentences.text: Jones told the jury Joanne had believed her husband was performing the sexual act on her when in reality he was "stage managing another unknown person" who was "taking his place without her knowledge".
sentences.article_title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told

sentences.text: Jones told the jury Young had advertised Joanne online, seeking "strangers to come and sleep with his wife".
sentences.article_title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told

sentences.text: "He presented it as a kink for both of them, but there was no information from Joanne herself to support this and the photos he posted of her to advertise his offer showed her inanimate and tied to the bed blindfolded," Jones told the court.
sentences.article_title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told

sentences.text: The court was told he had responded to an advert on Craigslist.
sentences.article_title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told

sentences.text: Jones said there was a video which showed Sanderson-Doyle wearing a balaclava while touching Joanne, who was shackled to a bed.
sentences.article_title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told

sentences.text: The video later showed Joanne protesting and Sanderson-Doyle apologising before continuing to touch her.
sentences.article_title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told

sentences.text: Jones told the jury Sanderson-Doyle had made "no further enquiry" that what he was doing was "welcome or acceptable" and had only stopped when Young said "No, let go".

sentences.text: The court heard this had prompted Young to stop filming before showing Sanderson-Doyle the door.
sentences.article_title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told

sentences.text: Jones said Sanderson-Doyle had said he believed Joanne had consented and he thought the married couple were "trying to live out whatever their kink" was.

sentences.article_title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told

sentences.text: Jones told the jury Macksoni had been filmed having sex with Young, who was  blindfolded and shackled to the bed and whose "less than wholehearted" participation" was "wholly akin to what you might expect if someone were drugged".
sentences.article_title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told

sentences.text: The court heard the video showed Young reassuring his then-wife, whose speech was "slurred and confused" that she was not being recorded.
sentences.article_title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told

sentences.article_title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told

sentences.article_title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told

sentences.text: Wilkins, of Toothill, Swindon, Wiltshire, has pleaded not guilty to one count of rape and one of assault by penetration in 2016.

sentences.text: Jones told the jury a video showed Wilkins touching Joanne "without any attempt to rouse or have a word with her".
sentences.article_title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told

sentences.article_title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told

sentences.article_title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told

sentences.text: "The notion of checking with the woman who is so out of it she is snoring never seems to enter the minds of either," Jones told the jury, adding: "They have no interest in her consent." Jones said Wilkins had denied the offences and had answered no comment in police interview.
sentences.article_title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told

sentences.text: Mohammed Hassan, of Swindon, has pleaded not guilty to one count of sexual touching in 2023.
sentences.article_title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told

sentences.text: There is no video evidence of the incident, but Hassan was traced through messages with Young on Grindr inviting him to come over to the couple's home where Joanne would be tied up and "falling asleep", the court heard.
sentences.article_title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told

sentences.article_title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told

sentences.article_title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told

sentences.article_title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told

sentences.article_title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told

sentences.article_title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told

sentences.text: An experienced keeper at a Dutch zoo has died days after being mauled in a leopard enclosure, the safari park has confirmed.
sentences.article_title: Dutch zookeeper dies after being mauled by leopard

sentences.text: The woman, who had worked at Beekse Bergen park for 40 years, was caring for two Persian leopards in an indoor facility when she was attacked on Saturday.
sentences.article_title: Dutch zookeeper dies after being mauled by leopard

sentences.text: She sustained injuries to her head and neck and had emergency surgery, but the park confirmed her death on Tuesday.
sentences.article_title: Dutch zookeeper dies after being mauled by leopard

sentences.text: An independent investigation will be launched into the incident, it added in a statement.
sentences.article_title: Dutch zookeeper dies after being mauled by leopard

sentences.text: Announcing her death, Beekse Bergen - in the south of the Netherlands - said the keeper began her career there when she was 17 and had worked there on-and-off for four decades.
sentences.article_title: Dutch zookeeper dies after being mauled by leopard

sentences.text: "Her passing has deeply affected us all, and our hearts go out to her family, friends, and loved ones.
sentences.article_title: Dutch zookeeper dies after being mauled by leopard

sentences.text: At this moment, our primary focus is on supporting her family and her colleagues," the statement added.
sentences.article_title: Dutch zookeeper dies after being mauled by leopard

sentences.text: The two leopards, which are usually kept away from staff, had been brought inside due to bad weather conditions.
sentences.article_title: Dutch zookeeper dies after being mauled by leopard

sentences.text: It is not clear exactly what happened in the enclosure because there are no CCTV cameras inside.
sentences.article_title: Dutch zookeeper dies after being mauled by leopard

sentences.text: Local news website NL Times reported that despite her injuries she managed to alert colleagues via her walkie-talkie.
sentences.article_title: Dutch zookeeper dies after being mauled by leopard

sentences.text: She was then taken to hospital in a helicopter in a critical condition.
sentences.article_title: Dutch zookeeper dies after being mauled by leopard

sentences.text: A park spokesperson told Omroep Brabant, a local media outlet, that the leopards were behaving naturally and they would not be euthanised.
sentences.article_title: Dutch zookeeper dies after being mauled by leopard

sentences.text: "They are, and remain, predators." Beekse Bergen said it would create a memorial location for guests and staff members to share their condolences.

sentences.text: Business Secretary Jonathan Reynolds says no "assumptions" have been made about what the future UK-EU relationship could look like British and European officials will discuss the future options for the UK's relationship with the EU, Business Secretary Jonathan Reynolds has told the BBC.
sentences.article_title: UK and EU officials to discuss freedom of movement

sentences.text: Officials on both sides are expected to begin discussions about a range of options, including free movement, before the EU summit on 20 November.
sentences.article_title: UK and EU officials to discuss freedom of movement

sentences.text: However, Downing Street has insisted the government's current focus is on achieving new deals in areas such as food and youth mobility at the summit.
sentences.article_title: UK and EU officials to discuss freedom of movement

sentences.text: Reynolds said no "assumptions" had been made about what the UK's future relationship with Brussels could look like.
sentences.article_title: UK and EU officials to discuss freedom of movement

sentences.text: Andy Burnham has said he wants an "honest discussion" about the prospect of returning to free movement between the UK and EU.
sentences.article_title: UK and EU officials to discuss freedom of movement

sentences.text: But the prime minister has been clear any major changes to the UK-EU relationship would require a mandate at a general election, which is due by 2029.
sentences.article_title: UK and EU officials to discuss freedom of movement

sentences.text: He has vowed to stick by the red lines in Labour's 2024 manifesto, with no return to freedom of movement, the EU single market or customs union, for the duration of this parliamentary session, which will end by 2029.
sentences.article_title: UK and EU officials to discuss freedom of movement

sentences.text: Freedom of movement, which allows EU citizens to travel, live, study and work in any member country, is a precondition of membership of the EU's single market.
sentences.article_title: UK and EU officials to discuss freedom of movement

sentences.text: The single market enables goods, services and people to move freely between member states, with countries also applying many common rules and standards.
sentences.article_title: UK and EU officials to discuss freedom of movement

sentences.text: He said: "What the prime minister has also said, quite rightly, is we face a series of policy changes on the European side that will affect us.
sentences.article_title: UK and EU officials to discuss freedom of movement

sentences.text: "We need to get as little uncertainty as possible, we need to have a way to resolve what our long-term relationship will be and he is going to set that out after the summit.
sentences.article_title: UK and EU officials to discuss freedom of movement

sentences.text: "He is going to be frank with the British people about what the trade-offs are but no assumptions have been made on that." Pressed on whether UK officials are talking to the EU about freedom of movement Reynolds said: "They will be talking to them about what the future options for our relationship might be.
sentences.article_title: UK and EU officials to discuss freedom of movement

sentences.text: "But here and now, the focus should be on the summit and the tangible difference improvements we're going to make." A government spokesperson stressed there were no current discussions on freedom of movement.
sentences.article_title: UK and EU officials to discuss freedom of movement

sentences.text: "We are working with the EU on the areas set out and agreed ahead of the UK-EU Summit and within the manifesto red lines," the spokesperson added.
sentences.article_title: UK and EU officials to discuss freedom of movement

sentences.text: Burnham is far more willing to have a public conversation around Brexit than his predecessor Sir Keir Starmer, whose government was nervous about reopening a debate that proved so contentious in the past.
sentences.article_title: UK and EU officials to discuss freedom of movement

sentences.text: Some people within the Labour Party had been urging Sir Keir to go further and there is a widely held view that Burnham's comments are likely to go down well with voters tempted by the Liberal Democrats and Greens.
sentences.article_title: UK and EU officials to discuss freedom of movement

sentences.text: But there is nervousness among Labour MPs with small majorities in Brexit-supporting, Reform-facing constituencies.
sentences.article_title: UK and EU officials to discuss freedom of movement

sentences.text: Labour MP Melanie Onn, whose constituency Great Grimsby and Cleethorpes backed leaving the EU, told the Today programme Burnham risked losing trust by talking about going beyond the 2024 manifesto at a future election.
sentences.article_title: UK and EU officials to discuss freedom of movement

sentences.text: "I don't think that the scars have healed for many people around the country so I do think this is an unnecessary conversation to be having at this time," she said.
sentences.article_title: UK and EU officials to discuss freedom of movement

sentences.text: We must respect the Brexit referendum result." Asked if a referendum on freedom of movement was something she would support, the MP for Newport West and Islwyn said: "We're a long way from that.
sentences.article_title: UK and EU officials to discuss freedom of movement

sentences.text: On Monday, Burnham left the door open to a potential referendum on freedom of movement with the EU.
sentences.article_title: UK and EU officials to discuss freedom of movement

sentences.text: The prime minister caused some confusion when he told broadcasters that he would not reintroduce free movement without a referendum, but Downing Street later said no decisions had been made on whether a public vote would be needed.
sentences.article_title: UK and EU officials to discuss freedom of movement

sentences.text: Housing Secretary Angela Rayner told the BBC on Sunday that no options for the UK's future relationship could be taken off the table.
sentences.article_title: UK and EU officials to discuss freedom of movement

sentences.text: But Burnham did appear to draw some red lines of his own when he told the Sunday Times , external that he would not be in favour of the UK joining the euro or the border-free Schengen zone.
sentences.article_title: UK and EU officials to discuss freedom of movement

sentences.text: The fact the prime minister has not been willing to say the same thing about free movement is being seen in Westminster as evidence that he believes it is a genuine option.
sentences.article_title: UK and EU officials to discuss freedom of movement

sentences.text: The unnamed celebrity is seeking an injunction, and his legal team told the first day of a trial on Tuesday that any publication would be "highly likely" to lead him to kill himself.
sentences.article_title: Unnamed celebrity accused of 'inappropriate sexual activities', court hears

sentences.text: They told the court that his drastic reaction was not because of any wrongdoing, but because of the fear of "trial by media".
sentences.article_title: Unnamed celebrity accused of 'inappropriate sexual activities', court hears

sentences.text: The man denies abusing "his power and position as a celebrity to contact and forge relationships with young women and teenagers to try to have sex with them", the court heard.
sentences.article_title: Unnamed celebrity accused of 'inappropriate sexual activities', court hears

sentences.text: The legal team for ITN and Guardian News and Media (GNM) told the court that the celebrity's "suicide risk" could be mitigated and there was no proper basis "to restrain the publication of public interest journalism".
sentences.article_title: Unnamed celebrity accused of 'inappropriate sexual activities', court hears

sentences.text: A medical report carried out for the court said inpatient treatment could provide "significant, but not complete mitigation of the risk", but that treatment, perhaps for months, had "a realistic potential to reduce the risk".
sentences.article_title: Unnamed celebrity accused of 'inappropriate sexual activities', court hears

sentences.text: The judge, Mr Justice Nicklin, said there was "significant public interest" in the proceedings and that "this is a difficult and important case".
sentences.article_title: Unnamed celebrity accused of 'inappropriate sexual activities', court hears

sentences.text: He added: "The court must determine it fairly, on the evidence and legal submissions." Nicklin will not determine the truth or accuracy of the allegations, only whether they can be published.
sentences.article_title: Unnamed celebrity accused of 'inappropriate sexual activities', court hears

sentences.text: He also urged the press and public not to speculate about the identity of the man, who is referred to in court as PPT.
sentences.article_title: Unnamed celebrity accused of 'inappropriate sexual activities', court hears

sentences.text: "The existence of online speculation, however confidently expressed or widely repeated, does not authorise anyone to identify, or purport authoritatively to identify, PPT in connection with these proceedings," he said.
sentences.article_title: Unnamed celebrity accused of 'inappropriate sexual activities', court hears

sentences.text: "Nor does repetition transform speculation into established fact." Sara Mansoori KC, representing the man, told the court that any publication "would have a potentially fatal impact".
sentences.article_title: Unnamed celebrity accused of 'inappropriate sexual activities', court hears

sentences.text: She added in written submissions: "This is not a case where an individual has spuriously raised 'mental health' concerns in the face of an impending publication that they do not wish to occur.
sentences.article_title: Unnamed celebrity accused of 'inappropriate sexual activities', court hears

sentences.text: "The claimant has attempted suicide twice as a result of these matters, been hospitalised for months, been the subject of involuntary detention and been examined by multiple - now more than 10 - doctors." Mansoori also said the man "has no intention of returning to public life".
sentences.article_title: Unnamed celebrity accused of 'inappropriate sexual activities', court hears

sentences.text: Gavin Millar KC, for ITN and GNM, said in written submissions that "numerous allegations" had been gathered during "a wide-ranging and rigorous investigation" and that there was a "strong" public interest in publishing them.
sentences.article_title: Unnamed celebrity accused of 'inappropriate sexual activities', court hears

sentences.text: He said reporters had spoken to more than 100 people, and that the resulting allegations "indicated a pattern of behaviour".
sentences.article_title: Unnamed celebrity accused of 'inappropriate sexual activities', court hears

sentences.text: Millar later said many of the women "have been traumatised by the claimant's alleged conduct and have suffered mental health crises and mental illness as a result".
sentences.article_title: Unnamed celebrity accused of 'inappropriate sexual activities', court hears

sentences.text: He added that while the state may have a responsibility to protect life, applying that principle to this case would require the state to intervene in "lawful journalistic activities" to prevent "an autonomous act by the claimant himself".

sentences.text: Conor Haughey (right) struck the winning penalty for Fleetwood Town against Arsenal to send the club through to the EFL Cup quarter-final for the first time Given their league positions, form and pedigree there could only have been one winner predicted.
sentences.article_title: 'Biggest night in the club's history' for fearless Fleetwood

sentences.text: Fleetwood played Arsenal on Tuesday with 83 places separating the teams and most home fans arriving in hope rather than any expectation.
sentences.article_title: 'Biggest night in the club's history' for fearless Fleetwood

sentences.text: But remarkably, it was the hosts who booked their place in the Carabao Cup quarter-final thanks to their penalty shootout win over the Gunners.
sentences.article_title: 'Biggest night in the club's history' for fearless Fleetwood

sentences.text: For the Cod Army, who won six promotions in 12 years in their impressive journey from non-league, this result will surely be remembered longest of all.
sentences.article_title: 'Biggest night in the club's history' for fearless Fleetwood

sentences.text: Against the reigning Premier League champions, the club from a small seaside town in Lancashire created history in claiming one of the biggest cup upsets ever.
sentences.article_title: 'Biggest night in the club's history' for fearless Fleetwood

sentences.text: Aaron Loupalo-Bi gave the hosts the lead after 21 minutes but, after the break, Viktor Gyokeres pulled the visitors level.
sentences.article_title: 'Biggest night in the club's history' for fearless Fleetwood

sentences.text: And from there, they might have been expected to take charge but Fleetwood remained resolute, prospering from a wasteful performance from Arsenal that included Max Dowman being sent off for kicking out after a robust challenge from Harrison Neal.
sentences.article_title: 'Biggest night in the club's history' for fearless Fleetwood

sentences.text: Fleetwood, who sit 18th in League Two having won just once in their past eight league games, dared to dream and took the game to penalties, with fans spilling on to the pitch in the after Conor Haughey's decisive spot kick.
sentences.article_title: 'Biggest night in the club's history' for fearless Fleetwood

sentences.text: "The biggest night in the club's history in terms of opposition coming to town and we've managed to beat the champions," boss Matt Lawlor told Sky Sports in the aftermath of his side's stunning victory.
sentences.article_title: 'Biggest night in the club's history' for fearless Fleetwood

sentences.text: "I'm a big football fan and I watch National League all the way through to the Premier League, Championship.
sentences.article_title: 'Biggest night in the club's history' for fearless Fleetwood

sentences.text: So for me it was a tough game to prepare for, but I'm just so glad that the lads have the feeling the way they are and took that performance in to make that town, the club, everyone proud." sentences.article_title: 'Biggest night in the club's history' for fearless Fleetwood

sentences.text: "It's unbelievable for the town and hopefully we can get someone else at home and do exactly the same thing," he said.

sentences.text: Jayden Long, 19, and Eddie Hill, 20, died walking on a mountain ridge in Eryri More people could die on remote mountains unless police do a better job in responding to dropped 999 calls, a coroner has warned.

sentences.text: The bodies of friends Eddie Hill, 20, and Jayden Long, 19, both from Dereham, Norfolk, were found on a mountain ridge in Eryri, also known as Snowdonia , on 19 February, a day after a call from Long to North Wales Police was disconnected.

sentences.text: The application was submitted after Ashfield District Council said it had received reports from local residents that the buildings were being used for purposes which were "not in line with the approved planning use class for the land".
sentences.article_title: Council rejects rollercoaster overlooking homes

sentences.text: Application documents show the site was previously classed as being used for storage only, but was actually being used for both storage and manufacturing.
sentences.article_title: Council rejects rollercoaster overlooking homes

sentences.text: The application form states the change in use had started on 1 June 2025 without consent , external and involves the test assembly, dismantling and maintenance of amusement attractions within the existing site, including the use of the listed hangars and external operational areas.
sentences.article_title: Council rejects rollercoaster overlooking homes

sentences.text: The site began to change in June 2025 In the council's decision notice rejecting the change in use, the authority said rollercoasters would "detract the setting and appreciation" of the hangars at the aerodrome site.
sentences.article_title: Council rejects rollercoaster overlooking homes

sentences.text: Concerns were raised that workers repairing and inspecting rollercoasters at height could result in an "unacceptable perception and loss of privacy for neighbouring occupiers".
sentences.article_title: Council rejects rollercoaster overlooking homes

sentences.text: The notice also said the application had failed to demonstrate the planned rollercoaster testing depot could operate without negatively impacting its neighbours and the planned use had "potential to generate significant noise".
sentences.article_title: Council rejects rollercoaster overlooking homes

sentences.text: Concerns were raised about privacy for nearby homes James Mellor, director of the Mellors Group, said there had been "delays" with sending off the rollercoaster to be painted before being put out for public use.
sentences.article_title: Council rejects rollercoaster overlooking homes

sentences.text: "It's been a very, very difficult year with multiple different issues, especially issues we've had at the Middle East," said Mellor.
sentences.article_title: Council rejects rollercoaster overlooking homes

sentences.text: Mellor said war in the region was causing shipping delays for materials and preventing work from taking place.
sentences.article_title: Council rejects rollercoaster overlooking homes

sentences.text: He added: "So it's just been there a lot longer than what was ever anticipated, even on our behalf.
sentences.article_title: Council rejects rollercoaster overlooking homes

sentences.text: We want the coaster out as quick as possible." Mellor added he wanted the change of use to be able to "work on other rides".
sentences.article_title: Council rejects rollercoaster overlooking homes

sentences.text: "Most rides are nowhere near the size of the coaster," he said.
sentences.article_title: Council rejects rollercoaster overlooking homes

sentences.text: "A lot of things will actually be done below the fence line where people can't see.
sentences.article_title: Council rejects rollercoaster overlooking homes

sentences.text: Ashlea Simon said she was arrested after her social media posts visiting HMOs in Salford The former co-leader of the far-right Britain First party has said she was arrested as part of an investigation into attacks on houses in multiple occupation (HMOs).
sentences.article_title: Ex-Britain First leader arrested in HMO attacks investigation

sentences.text: In a post on X, Ashlea Simon said she had been held at Manchester Airport after "returning from a family holiday".
sentences.article_title: Ex-Britain First leader arrested in HMO attacks investigation

sentences.text: Greater Manchester Police (GMP) said a 37-year-old woman had been arrested on suspicion of "conspiracy to cause criminal damage",  following a spate of incidents in which HMOs were vandalised across the Greater Manchester region.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Britain First leader arrested in HMO attacks investigation

sentences.text: Simon, who said in her post that she "hasn't committed a crime in her life", was approached for comment by the Local Democracy Reporting Service (LDRS).
sentences.article_title: Ex-Britain First leader arrested in HMO attacks investigation

sentences.text: In the post, Simon said she believed the arrest was linked to a series of videos she has made since July.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Britain First leader arrested in HMO attacks investigation

sentences.text: In them, she claimed to identify several HMOs in her hometown of Walkden, Salford.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Britain First leader arrested in HMO attacks investigation

sentences.text: In a previous video shared by Simon in recent days, she said police had "raided" her home while she was on holiday and she was aware of an "arrest warrant".
sentences.article_title: Ex-Britain First leader arrested in HMO attacks investigation

sentences.text: Simon left Britain First two years ago, and is now the leader of a "pro-English" activism group.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Britain First leader arrested in HMO attacks investigation

sentences.text: The news of her arrest came amid a major investigation into a number of vandalism attacks across Salford, Tameside, and Stockport.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Britain First leader arrested in HMO attacks investigation

sentences.text: Police are investigating about 50 incidents in which HMOs and family homes have been vandalised and cars targeted.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Britain First leader arrested in HMO attacks investigation

sentences.text: In one incident, a pig's head was left outside a home.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Britain First leader arrested in HMO attacks investigation

sentences.text: Five men have been arrested on suspicion of causing criminal damage and conspiracy to cause criminal damage as part of the investigation, along with a 13-year-old boy.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Britain First leader arrested in HMO attacks investigation

sentences.text: On Friday, Ch Supt Marcus Noden said officers "suspect vulnerable people are being exploited and paid to damage buildings they believe are HMOs".
sentences.article_title: Ex-Britain First leader arrested in HMO attacks investigation

sentences.text: "Some of those being exploited are believed to be children and this is just one line of enquiry that we are pursuing," he added.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Britain First leader arrested in HMO attacks investigation

sentences.text: There were 1,152 alcohol-specific deaths registered in Scotland, a decrease of 3% compared with 2024.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: The Scottish government said the drop amounted to progress and that it would invest £160m this year on alcohol and drugs programmes.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: But one mother from Aberdeen whose daughter died alone after decades fighting alcoholism described her illness as "relentless" and said sometimes all the resources available are still not enough to beat it.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: Paula Gibson's daughter Clare died in November 2023, aged 45, after spending the last 20 years of her life in and out of rehab.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: She had periods of sobriety, but ultimately died at home alone.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: The 72-year-old said her daughter started struggling with alcohol in her early-20s but over the next decade her behaviour escalated, even with help and and interventions.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: This led to Clare's parents taking custody of her youngest son, Craig, who was eight at the time.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: "It probably took about 10 years of feeling like something wasn't quite right, while trying to support her through conversations, but it wasn't enough.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: "Her behaviour was extreme and the impact it had on all of us was really difficult.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: "We were living on a knife edge, not knowing what the next phone call would be or what would happen to her next.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: "Her wellbeing became compromised.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: She was not making any rational decisions or the right choices for her or her kids," she said.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: Craig went to stay with his grandparents when he was eight With both of Clare's sons living with their grandparents, the family tried to maintain their relationship, but it became difficult when the addiction took over, Paula said.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: "We were at family centres trying to negotiate any kind of relationship with the boys.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: We tried to always keep contact between them because you want them to always be a family.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: "But she would rock up drunk and we would have to cancel the meetings immediately or I would go to her house to pick her up and she'd fall into the car with a bottle of vodka in her bag.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: "It was dreadful and mortifyingly embarrassing and difficult for the boys." Clare grew up in Aberdeen Things escalated months before Clare's death when she went into rehab while her younger son and parents went on a holiday to Greece.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: She didn't make it through rehab and during a hospital stay was told that if she did not change her lifestyle she would die.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: Paula said the boys had been looking forward to seeing their mother after rehab in a safe setting and breaking the news was one of the hardest moments of her life.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: She said: "It was utterly destroying.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: "Clare had been sober leading up to this and phoned me in floods of tears and emotion in a very genuine way.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: "We were both weeping on the phone and I told her to go back into rehab and she would get through this.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: "I told her I loved her and I would see her when we got back from Greece." When the family got back, they received a phone call from a painter who was doing work in the house, who had found Clare.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: She was not in rehab and had passed out drunk at the bottom of a set of stairs.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: "We drove back from Glasgow Airport to Aberdeen and I had to tell them mum had failed rehab and they couldn't see her because she was drunk.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: "This was the hardest thing ever because this time we really thought she was on the road to recovery.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: "Within two months she was dead," Paula said.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: On the night she died, Clare had reached out to emergency services overnight but it was a social worker who found her in the morning.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: She died of fatty liver disease, or alcohol-related liver disease (ARLD), where the liver is damaged by drinking too much alcohol over a long period.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: Paula spent over 20 years supporting her daughter and said they had all the resources you could need - but sometimes that it is not enough.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: She said, despite everything, Clare left a financial legacy so her children would be looked after.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: "We spent so many decades living on edge and waiting for that phone call, so that when we found out Clare had died there was a sense of relief - she was finally at peace.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: "The alcoholism is a self-fulfilling prophecy and a nasty cycle of horror for those in it and everyone around them.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: "The whole family suffers.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: "She was just like Jekyll and Hyde with a drink, that's the reality and it is hell." Scottish Health Action on Alcohol Problems said they welcomed the fall in alcohol deaths but raised concern over rising deaths among women.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: Charity chairman, Dr Alastair MacGilchrist, said: "It is deeply concerning that while deaths among men have fallen, deaths among women have risen.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: "Despite this year's fall, deaths remain higher than they were before Covid, and people living in Scotland's most deprived areas are now 4.8 times more likely to die from alcohol than those in the least deprived.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: "That is not a situation we can accept as the new normal.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: It is a reason to act," he added.
sentences.article_title: Women's alcohol deaths are increasing - my daughter died alone after fighting for decades

sentences.text: One user said Apple had helped him to replace his faulty iPhone Duo Apple has acknowledged some of its iPhone Duo handsets have developed problems with their screens, just days after the highly-anticipated smartphone went on sale.
sentences.article_title: Apple to replace iPhone Duos affected by screen problem

sentences.text: Photos posted on social media show lines that appeared on the screens of the technology giant's first ever foldable device , which has a starting price of £1,999 ($2,668) in the UK.
sentences.article_title: Apple to replace iPhone Duos affected by screen problem

sentences.text: Apple said it was aware of "an issue impacting the inner display on a small number" of the phones and urged affected users to contact the company for a replacement.
sentences.article_title: Apple to replace iPhone Duos affected by screen problem

sentences.text: The Duo's launch, which attracted crowds at Apple stores around the world last week, is an attempt to reinvigorate the brand's device range and challenge the foldable phones made by rivals.
sentences.article_title: Apple to replace iPhone Duos affected by screen problem

sentences.text: Some Duo owners also posted photos online showing cracks along the screen's centre crease, while others reported a crunching noise when opening the device.
sentences.article_title: Apple to replace iPhone Duos affected by screen problem

sentences.text: An iPhone Duo user, Justin Lokos, posted an image of a device with lines across the right side of the display and later uploaded a picture of a new handset alongside the broken one, thanking an Apple store in New York for its help.
sentences.article_title: Apple to replace iPhone Duos affected by screen problem

sentences.text: The extent of the issue remains unclear.
sentences.article_title: Apple to replace iPhone Duos affected by screen problem

sentences.text: Apple did not say how many devices were affected, while some images showing faulty devices may have been created using AI.
sentences.article_title: Apple to replace iPhone Duos affected by screen problem

sentences.text: Francisco Jeronimo, technology analyst at market research firm IDC, said that meant some caution was needed before drawing conclusions about the whole production run.
sentences.article_title: Apple to replace iPhone Duos affected by screen problem

sentences.text: But he added the early reports of issues also showed "that even a company with Apple's engineering resources and supply chain discipline faces a steep learning curve in foldables".
sentences.article_title: Apple to replace iPhone Duos affected by screen problem

sentences.text: The Duo's 7.6-inch (19.3cm) inner display is held together by a central hinge - a complex piece of engineering that has resulted in similar flaws in folding devices made by some of Apple's competitors.
sentences.article_title: Apple to replace iPhone Duos affected by screen problem

sentences.text: Samsung's first foldable phone, the Galaxy Fold, suffered an early setback in 2019 when reviewers reported broken screens on the devices.
sentences.article_title: Apple to replace iPhone Duos affected by screen problem

sentences.text: Apple boss John Ternus showing off the new iPhone Duo Android users already have a broad selection of foldable phones to choose from, technology that Apple spent years developing before the Duo's release.
sentences.article_title: Apple to replace iPhone Duos affected by screen problem

sentences.text: It is Apple's most expensive iPhone ever, costing up to £3,199 for the most well-equipped models.
sentences.article_title: Apple to replace iPhone Duos affected by screen problem

sentences.text: Jeronimo said because Apple had positioned the Duo as a "premium alternative" to established foldables, "how it handles this first-generation issue will shape buyer confidence in the category well beyond its own sales".
sentences.article_title: Apple to replace iPhone Duos affected by screen problem

sentences.text: "Apple has a loyal customer base and a retail network that can swap devices on the spot, but with a further 28 markets launching on 30 October, it needs to clarify its warranty position quickly," he said.
sentences.article_title: Apple to replace iPhone Duos affected by screen problem

sentences.text: The Duo marks Apple's first major iPhone redesign in almost two decades and was unveiled by new chief executive John Ternus, who took over from Tim Cook in September.
sentences.article_title: Apple to replace iPhone Duos affected by screen problem

sentences.text: When closed, the Duo looks like a wider version of an iPhone, then opens up to a device resembling a small tablet computer.
sentences.article_title: Apple to replace iPhone Duos affected by screen problem

sentences.text: "Others have created foldables that just feel like two phones awkwardly stuck together", Ternus told an audience at Apple's California headquarters last month.
sentences.article_title: Apple to replace iPhone Duos affected by screen problem

sentences.text: The Duo, he said, would "redefine the experience of using a foldable phone".
